title: Compact convex separation upgrades all-frame witnesses to one channel

labels: From a frame to one full-channel comparison

statement.quantifiers: For every supplied channel satisfying LA001, there EXISTS one full-domain canonical EB Psi; d>=2, m=ceil(log2(d^2)).
statement.assertion: I-Psi <=_HS 2m(I-Phi). For rho_H=(I+H)/d, ||H||_infinity<=theta<1, r=sup_H||Phi(H)-H||_1,tau, the SAME Psi satisfies sup_H T(Psi(rho_H),rho_H)<=sqrt(2m theta r)/2.
assumptions: Cone order is on the real Hermitian HS space, not matrix Loewner order on density operators.
Tr H=0 and rho_H are states; half-trace normalization.

inputs: Supplied broadcaster and channel; optional bounded tracial likelihood family.
outputs: Existential one common EB comparator; logarithmic-dimensional loss.
interface.precision: Exact compactness and separation argument; no algorithm for selecting finite support.
costs: Caratheodory gives finite-outcome representative of first and second moments, not polynomial-time acquisition.
Raw tree/outcome costs from LA001 remain.

proof_mechanism: Decompose any positive dual Q into at most d^2 weighted rank-one frame directions.
Canonical POVM channels form compact convex image of probability measures with barycenter I/d; retain mixing coin; separate this set from translated PSD cone.
Canonical Psi is positive HS contraction, so (I-Psi)^2<=I-Psi; Schatten monotonicity gives trace error.
obstructions: r log d->0 is sufficient; bounded Holevo does not imply it.
Failure in canonical measurement subclass would not rule out arbitrary EB comparators.
No dimension-free constant or hardware compiler follows.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Provide r log d control and the same tracial interface before transporting this estimate.

generalisations.hypothesis: Exploit extra channel structure to remove log dimension.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
